Integrum Content:
1. Blended solar and wind generation, structured under open access or group captive, to displace grid and DG power at a lower, contracted tariff. The hybrid profile smooths intermittency — wind fills the hours solar can't — so you get firmer daytime and evening coverage than a single-source plant. We structure the commercial model (open access, or a group captive SPV that meets the 26% equity / 51% consumption thresholds) around your load, tariff category, and state policy, so the savings survive regulatory scrutiny.
 
 2. Generation behind your meter, where every unit produced offsets a unit you'd otherwise buy at retail tariff — the highest-value avoided cost available to you. We pair on-site solar with battery storage (BESS) to shift generation into peak-tariff windows, cut demand charges, and hold critical loads through outages.
 
 3. One accountable partner across the asset's life, so performance risk doesn't get split across vendors who can each blame the other. We design and size the system to your load and tariff, execute EPC to commissioning, and run O&M against contracted availability and generation guarantees. A live monitoring layer tracks generation, consumption, and realised savings against the model — surfacing underperformance before it shows up on your bill, not after.
Remarks: Green Hydrogen is something which we are not focusing on right now
